findings.title: Arabic text forced to the left
findings.message: This right-to-left text is aligned left.
findings.fix: Use text-align: start.

findings.title: Punctuation at the wrong end
findings.message: "325.000 ر.ع." runs left to right, so its last mark moves to the start.
findings.fix: Give the block the direction of its own text, with dir="ltr", dir="rtl" or dir="auto".

findings.title: Punctuation at the wrong end
findings.message: "111.299 ر.ع." runs left to right, so its last mark moves to the start.
findings.fix: Give the block the direction of its own text, with dir="ltr", dir="rtl" or dir="auto".

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: Arabic falls back from Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: Arabic set too small
findings.fix: Keep Arabic UI text at 14px or more, and body text at 16px.
